narrative.title: The Rally Chant Census
narrative.scenario: A stadium anthem archive studies crowd chants. Analysts slice a chant recording into every contiguous syllable run and want to know how many unique runs exist — duplicates collapse into one. The empty run counts too. Two runs are the same only when their syllables match exactly.
narrative.inputFormat: A string s of lowercase letters.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the number of distinct substrings of s, including the empty substring.

testCases.explanation: Distinct non-empty runs: a, b, ab, ba, aba, bab, abab — 7 of them; the canonical count adds the empty run for 8.
a, aa, aaa plus the empty run.

hintLevels: Level 1: Every substring is a prefix of some suffix — feed all suffixes into one trie.
Level 2: Each newly created trie node during the suffix insertions is one new distinct substring.
Level 3: Count node creations and add 1 for the empty string; no dedup structure beyond the trie is needed.
